facts.claim: Material radio defaults props.tabindex to -1. After view initialization it observes field.focus; when tabindex is -1, focus is truthy and radios exist, it schedules focus on the selected radio or otherwise the first radio. It unsubscribes the focus observer on destruction.
facts.context: radio focus tabindex selected first button field.focus
limits: This describes the pinned implementation, not a public API to call private radio internals or a guarantee of all keyboard, scroll or focus timing behavior.
